search_text: published ZDI-15-220 ZDI-CAN-2425 ManageEngine EventLog Analyzer UploadHandlerServlet File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-05-13 CVE-2014-6037 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-6037 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['ManageEngine'] ['EventLog Analyzer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ManageEngine EventLog Analyzer. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UploadHandlerServlet servlet. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize the filenames uploaded to the servlet. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of SYSTEM. Upgrade to version 10.0 build 10001 or higher, to address this vulnerability.
